main:1.text: An Offer You Can't Refuse is the first mission of the storyline in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Tommy Angelo recounts his first encounter with the mafia, during a night in 1930. The year was 1930. Taxi driver Tommy Angelo was on his routine night shift when he heard gunfire around the corner from his parked taxi. Paulie Lombardo and Sam Trapani  find Tommy and hitch a ride in his taxi to escape his pursuers.

main:2.text: Running Man is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. A few days after his run-in with Paulie and Sam, Tommy returned to work with his taxi. However, Dino and Lou, begin to beat him and trash his taxi as punishment from Don Morello for Tommy aiding in Paulie and Sam's escape.

main:3.text: Molotov Party is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. The scene starts in the meeting room of Salieri's Bar, where Tommy explains to the Salieri family how his taxi was damaged. With Salieri's permission, Tommy and Paulie make their way to Morello's Lounge Bar across town. There, they exact revenge on the Morello family by smashing and torching their cars.

main:4.text: Ordinary Routine is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Tommy, Paulie, and Sam  are doing their regular collection rounds. Meet Vincenzo, where he'll teach Tommy how to shoot, then go to Ralph, where he'll instruct Tommy on how to pick a car's lock. Next, get Paulie and Sam to begin the collection rounds.

main:5.text: Fair Play is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. It's 1932 and the Lost Heaven Grand Prix is around the corner. Paulie, Sam, Don Salieri, and other fellow race fans put their money on Mikey Dunne, a local racing driver whom Salieri has loaned money to before.

main:6.text: One night, when Salieri's Bar is about to close, Luigi asked Tommy  to take his daughter home in order to keep her safe from a gang of punks who tried to make advances on her. Follow Sarah to the alleyways, where she'll make a stop at a nearby house to give some food. After a while, Tommy and Sarah will encounter a group of men, which has to be defeated. After defeating the punks, a cutscene will play.

main:7.text: Better Get Used to It is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Don Salieri is not pleased to know that a gang of punks have been harassing Sarah, and so he asks Tommy to teach them a lesson. Meet Vincenzo, who will give Tommy some bats for the job.

main:8.text: The Saint and the Sinner is a story mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Following the previous event, it was revealed that one of the hoodlum who Paulie capped was Billy Ghillotti, son of the city councilor. It was also revealed that Billy's accomplice Johnny survived the ordeal. This now places the Salieri Crime Family in danger as Billy's friend may be able to identify Tommy or Paulie.

main:9.text: A Trip to the Country is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. The year is 1933. During these days, Frank had to deal with day-to-day orders for the family, and this time, he wanted Tommy to help Sam and Paulie secure a shipment of booze from Canada. Head for Salieri's warehouse to meet Paulie. A cutscene will play, showing Paulie and Tommy heading to the countryside.

main:10.text: After the alcohol buy went to hell, Don Salieri has found out why. His good friend and consigliere, Frank Colletti, has turned over evidence to the state. Since Frank broke Omerta, the Mafia code of silence, Salieri wants him liquidated. No one knows where he is, so Tommy must visit three stoolies and get the info. After receiving your orders, go visit Vincenzo to collect a Colt 1911 and a Sawed-off Shotgun.

main:11.text: Visiting Rich People is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. While being driven by Carlo, Don Salieri told Tommy about a prosecutor whose on Morello's payroll and wiling to drop details about Salieri family's involvement in Billy Ghillotti's death. The Don instructed Tommy to meet Salvatore, a safecracking expert, and get rid of the incriminating evidence. Meet Salvatore, then head for the Prosecutor's mansion.

main:12.text: Great Deal is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. While supervising an activity at the warehouse, Paulie Lombardo told Don Salieri and the crew about a whiskey distiller named William Gates, whose father owns a distillery in Kentucky and exclusively supplies Kentucky whiskey to the Morello Crime Family.

main:13.text: Bon Appétit is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Don Salieri asks Tommy to take him to Pepe's Restaurant as his bodyguard Carlo called out sick. Once they arrive at the restaurant, they are greeted by its namesake owner, Pepe, who treats them to a lavish meal. As they eat, Tommy tells Salieri that Sarah threatened to leave him if he didn't "dry out".

main:14.text: Happy Birthday is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Don Salieri begins to put together a plan for taking apart the Morello Crime Family once and for all, and he hatches the first step in his plan.

main:15.text: You Lucky Bastard is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. With war now apparent between the Salieri and Morello crime families, Don Salieri resolves to have Sergio, Don Morello's younger brother and underboss killed. When Sam and Vincenzo fail to kill him in a car chase in the night, Tommy is dispatched to carry out the job.

main:16.text: Crème de la Crème is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Sergio's death results in an all-out gang war between the Salieri and Morello crime families with the former slowly winning. Don Morello, realizing that he's losing influence, decides to host a charity gala after being in hiding from some time.

main:17.text: Election Campaign is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. The year is 1938. Election day is coming, and Don Salieri is especially perturbed by Hank Turnbull, one of the gubnatorial candidates, for his promise to eradicate organised crime, threatening the Salieri Crime Family.

main:18.text: Just for Relaxation is a mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. A shipment of imported cigars belonging to Don Salieri had been impounded, and Tommy Angelo, Paulie Lombardo, and Sam Trapani are sent to reclaim them from the Federal Customs Impound.

main:19.text: Moonlighting is the penultimate storyline mission in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Following the cigar heist, Paulie persuaded Tommy to a rob the Grand Imperial Bank, which Tommy agreed to after Paulie ensured him that the score would retire them from criminal life, something that had taken its toll on the both of them. The walkthrough should serve as an abbreviated guide rather than a step-by-step tutorial.

main:20.text: The Death of Art is the final mission of the storyline in Mafia: Definitive Edition. The morning after the bank job, Tommy wakes up to a suspicious Sarah, who thinks that her husband is hiding something from her. Tommy eventually leaves after telling her to pack some bags. Tommy decided to pay Paulie Lombardo a visit at his apartment to decide what to do with the score from the bank robbery.
